# mockframe.com

> > Mockframe is a wireframing and prototyping platform transitioning from 500apps to 500agents, an AI-powered conversational platform.

Mockframe provides tools for creating wireframes, mockups, and prototypes with features like low-fidelity wireframing, image libraries, and project management. The platform is undergoing a strategic consolidation as part of the 500apps sunset, with customers migrating to the new 500agents AI platform.
